name: obix-compiler-script-setup
description: The <script setup> frontend of the .obix compiler: compiles the <script setup> (with any normal <script> it is merged with) of a canonical SFC with the OFFICIAL Vue script compiler — defineProps, defineEmits, withDefaults, defineExpose, defineOptions, defineSlots and defineModel included — into the same typed frontend artifact as obix-compiler-script, with the binding metadata the template stage needs, and reports what the compiler says under OBIX-owned diagnostic codes for every compiler macro, the props destructure and type resolution. Phase 3 of the VueTS compiler recovery (docs/recovery/vuets-compiler.md).
author: Nnamdi Michael Okpala <okpalan@protonmail.com>
